name: Bardhaman
summary: Separate English and Bengali first-party discovery evidenced West Bengal's official Banglarbhumi land-record/cadastral-map service and Purba Bardhaman local land-office custody. The anonymous Banglarbhumi request timed out before the current viewer configuration or a parcel response could be inspected. No safe native parcel ID, schema, CRS or full polygon was obtained; runtime remains held.
queryAndRequestOutcome: English and Bengali queries found official Banglarbhumi and official Purba Bardhaman district land-office/map pages. The direct Banglarbhumi GET timed out after 25 seconds with TLS verification enabled. Official indexed/service material documents Plot Info, Plot Map, Mouza Map and RS-LR services, but no city-specific public parcel payload was invented or retained.
